breakfast.name: Pão de Queijo (Brazilian Cheese Bread)
breakfast.description: Puffy, cheesy Brazilian bread made with tapioca starch, creating a naturally gluten-free treat with crispy exterior and soft, chewy interior. Best enjoyed fresh from the oven
instructions: Heat milk, oil, and salt in saucepan until steaming (do not boil)
Pour hot liquid into food processor with metal blade
While machine is running, add tapioca starch and cheese, process until dough forms
Add eggs one at a time through food chute while running
Stop and let dough cool for 2-3 minutes
Using piping bag or small spoon, pipe dough into greased muffin tins or small paper cups
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown and puffy
Serve immediately while warm when outside is crisp and inside is soft and chewy
breakfast.notes: Polvilho (tapioca starch) is essential - it gives pão de queijo its signature chewy texture. Cool dough slightly before piping for easier handling
breakfast.fun_fact: Pão de queijo is everywhere in Brazil as breakfast or afternoon coffee time (café da tarde). In Brazil it's traditionally made with mixture of polvilho doce and polvilho azedo
